evals.prompt: 我下周要在《土地经济学》课上汇报一篇论文（Regional Science and Urban Economics 上的一篇，PDF 在桌面上），30 分钟含提问，我说话偏慢。老师还要求联系中国现实、最后带一句自己的课程论文选题。帮我从头准备：讲稿 + slides。
evals.expected_output: Runs intake (duration/pace/extras), reads the paper, researches institutional background with traceable sources, writes a ~5000-character plain-language Chinese script with a length estimate, then builds slides extracted from the script with a visual QA loop.

evals.prompt: I have a 12-minute slot at a conference next month to present my own working paper (pdf attached). I need slides and speaker notes. The audience is applied micro economists.
evals.expected_output: Calibrates rigor for specialists (identification strategy gets real time), writes a ~1400-word English script first, distills a Beamer deck from it, renders and inspects every page, aligns speaker notes to slide pages.

evals.prompt: Help me turn this paper into a 20-minute journal club presentation. Mostly PhD students in the room, keep it informal but accurate, and I want figures from the paper in the deck.
evals.expected_output: Script-first workflow; extracts presentation-worthy paper figures at high resolution (no regression-table screenshots); uses the key-points page / figure page split; ends with fact-check and blind-audience review.

evals.prompt: 讲稿和 slides 都改完了，帮我做最后检查，然后出一份能打印出来带上讲台的讲稿。
evals.expected_output: Runs the fact-check against paper and sources, then a separate language proofread of the script (knowing typos propagate verbatim onto the slides and fixing both artifacts), then the blind-audience review; aligns page-turn markers to the frozen deck; produces the print-ready PDF and explains its markup conventions in one sentence.
